description: SNES emulators allow you to play games from the Super Nintendo Entertainment System on modern devices. Higan is recommended for fast computers while Snes9x has a friendlier UI. Both offer high compatibility and features like save states, cheat codes, and graphical enhancements.

description: DeSmuME is a Nintendo DS emulator for modern devices. It supports save states, cheat codes, and screen magnification if wanted. DeSmuME is known for its quality 3D rendering and high compatibility with the DS game library.

Genesis Plus GX is a SEGA multi-system emulator supporting Sega Genesis/Mega Drive, Sega CD, Master System, Game Gear, and SG-1000. The emulator offers high accuracy, save states, and various enhancement options.
Mesen is a high-accuracy multi-system emulator known for it's NES and Game Boy compatibility. It has cycle-accurate emulation, visual enchancements, and extensive debugging features.

Mupen64Plus is a highly compatible Nintendo 64 emulator. It provides high-resolution textures, save states, and smooth audio plugins. More advanced feautres are its cheat system and rumble pack support.
games: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

description: PCSX-ReARMed is a PlayStation 1 emulator optimized for ARM devices. It offers good compatibility and performance, making it popular for emulating PS1 games on mobile devices and single-board computers.

PCSX2 is a PlayStation 2 emulator that allows users to play PS2 games on PC. It supports high graphics, save states, and cheat codes. PCSX2 has high compatibility with the PS2 game library and continues to be actively developed.

PPSSPP (PlayStation Portable Simulator Suitable for Playing Portably) is a PSP emulator that runs on multiple platforms. It offers enhanced graphics, save states, and network play features, allowing users to enjoy PSP games with improved visuals.
games: God of War: Chains of Olympus
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories

description: Redream is a Sega Dreamcast emulator known for its easy setup, simple interface, and quality performance. It supports high-resolution rendering, save states, and controller remapping for accessibility.
